mapper.select: SELECT h.history_id, h.food_id, f.food_name, h.action_type, h.previous_storage_type, h.new_storage_type, h.quantity_text, h.created_at, h.changes_text FROM food_history h JOIN food_item f ON f.food_id = h.food_id ORDER BY h.created_at DESC, h.history_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO food_history (food_id, action_type, previous_storage_type, new_storage_type, quantity_text, memo, created_at, changes_text) VALUES (#{foodId}, #{actionType}, #{previousStorageType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{newStorageType}, #{quantityText,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{memo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{createdAt}, #{changesText,jdbcType=VARCHAR})
